decisive_finding.reproduction: After one successful initial-to-final flow, the same mediator and then a fresh mediator each accepted another flow using the unchanged single-use approval and session receipt.
decisive_finding.cause: Final validation consumed only the instance-local token and never centrally recorded approval and receipt identities as consumed.

required_correction: share one mediator-factory-private consumed-authorization registry across instances
atomically consume the complete approval member set receipt identity authorization-set binding and token on successful final validation
consume nothing on any precommit validation failure
reject same-mediator and fresh-mediator reuse while allowing distinct authorization identities
withhold cross-process restart and crash durability until a canonical durable root mediator exists
root_disposition: The proposal remains non-authoritative. The correction models only in-process atomic consumption; durable cross-process single-use authority remains unproved and blocks adoption.
no_claim_statement: This REWORK decision authorizes no external effect and changes no adopted contract, product behavior, claim ceiling, readiness, release, node closure, or goal-completion state.
